policy.isbn: primary_isbn ∉ isbn[]: add primary_isbn to isbn[] when Open Library titles it as this book AND (the wiki lists it OR it is the same OL work as a row ISBN); reset primary_isbn to a row ISBN when the evidence assigns it to another book; flag anything else. Operator-approved additions (listed in the builder, each in the row's wiki infobox and on no other row) are appended in the same write. Never removes an ISBN.
policy.covers: null/blank cover_image only: Open Library (every row ISBN), then Google Books (every row ISBN), then a Google Books title search accepted only when the hit lists a row ISBN; HEAD-checked against MIN_COVER_BYTES, never a cover another row uses, never a Wookieepedia image. Unreleased books without one are listed, not forced.
policy.synopsis: null/blank synopsis only: original one-line drafts (never wiki CC BY-SA prose or publisher blurbs), each marked drafted for review; rows without a confident draft are skipped and listed.
